facts.statement: The study used an exploratory secondary analysis of a large randomized trial.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: The analysis included 816 adults with acute stroke who received clot removal surgery.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: Researchers compared patients assigned to an intensive blood pressure lowering plan against those on a standard plan.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: The team tracked blood pressure readings taken over the first three days to calculate average levels and how much they fluctuated.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: Men who received intensive blood pressure control had worse long-term recovery scores than those on the standard plan.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: Women showed no clear difference in long-term recovery between the intensive and standard blood pressure plans.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: For men, higher average blood pressure in the first three days was linked to poorer recovery outcomes.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: The authors note that results for other health measures were similar but require further testing.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: The researchers state these results are preliminary and need confirmation in new studies before guiding treatment.
